description: A modern, minimalist nightstand featuring two drawers with grooved fronts. The body of the nightstand is primarily white with subtle red and blue accents visible on the top rear edge and a red panel on the side, adding a touch of color. The drawers are extended, showcasing their sleek design and the internal shelving. The base of the nightstand has a metallic trim. Its clean lines and neutral color palette make it a versatile piece for contemporary bedroom decor.
